exact_statement: The joint-row collision functional Gamma is TV-Lipschitz with constant a+(sqrt(2^a)+1)/ln2 independent of retained alphabet. Every one-point surgery satisfies |delta Gamma_A|<10*2^(-n/2) uniformly over proper blocks. With u_n=2^(1-floor(n/2)), n>=4, |delta V_A|<=a*u_n+h2(u_n)+rho_(n,a), rho=[a+(2^(a/2)+1)/ln2]*2^(1-a)*sqrt(2^(-(n-a))*(1-2^(-(n-a)))); strict fixed-price slack exceeding this plus2Ka2^-n transfers V_A<KI_A. A Boolean G at disagreement epsilon from a product across A admits lower-dimensional Boolean row phases with mass-weighted squared amplitude error<=16epsilon. A least-essential-dimension K-violation obtained by one-point surgery of that product obeys D_K(G)<=10sqrt(p)+psi_a(min(1,4sqrt(p)))+Ka min(1,4sqrt(p)). For the pinned NAND6 seed h, every one-point edit of h^(tensor t), t>=4, is prime/full-support, has H>(12/5)I, has all singleton collision prices above12/5 and a mask48 joint collision price below12/5, and retains a proper descendant +/-h violating12/5. This is not an unbounded-ratio family or a universal payment theorem.
